text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Blast Onepiece! It's Blast Onepiece!! 
The Classic-class Umamusume overcomes 
formidable rivals to conquer the Grand 
Prix!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The Arima Kinen. A grand showdown 
bringing together Umamusume 
who carried the blessings of everyone's 
support... and where I planned to finish 
it all.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Yet the reason why I still yearned for a 
racing outfit— 
why I resolved to get a new outfit so I 
could keep running—was...)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
To everyone who supported me! Can you hear 
me!? Bu is happy right now! 
The Bu that you all cheered on... is truly 
blessed!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because of that light that spread to me 
from you on that day.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I'm so glad we brought other 
formal wear along♪ 
Now then, let us begin!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The bride will now make her entrance. 
Please turn your eyes... toward the 
entrance...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Leading the way for the bride... are 
Blast-san and Dia-san...

text_block_list.name: Blast & Dia
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So beautiful... Isn't it wonderful, 
Gentile-senpai?! 
Blast-senpai and the others, and the 
flowers look so gorgeous...!

text_block_list.name: Ceremony Hall Ghost
text_block_list.text:
S　　　T　　　O　　　P　　　!　　!　! 
! 
Stop it... You stole my happiness! I don't 
want to see you happy!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Her voice is growing stronger...! 
Everyone can hear it...! 
Their... cursed grudge is amplifying...!

text_block_list.name: Bride Ghost
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah... b-big... sister...? I'm so sorry— 
My happiness only hurts you... I have to 
call off the ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...No, let's keep going!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You were happy, weren't you? Then it's 
fine! 
It's fine to hold a ceremony celebrating 
your happiness!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Because if you choose to give up, 
your happiness won't be seen! It won't 
reach anyone around you!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
If you don't express your feelings, 
they'll never reach others! 
Not even the people who cried tears of joy 
upon learning of my happiness.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That's why Bu will celebrate her own 
happiness with all her might! 
Because somewhere out of sight, there 
might be someone waiting for it!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you happy makes Sensei's heart feel 
so warm inside. 
Keep giving it your all, Bu-chan. ...Let's 
do our best tomorrow too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
People I met long ago, and those right 
beside me today. 
Among them... there might be someone 
waiting to see my happiness.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
If you're happy, say it out loud! Share 
it! 
Someone you may have forgotten might be 
waiting for your happiness.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—And that goes for you, too, holding that 
grudge. 
Don't let it end with just jealousy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Face your frustration, and look straight 
at their happiness. 
Even if it hurts to swallow... have the 
courage to offer your blessing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If you do, you'll surely be able to 
believe—"Next time, it's my turn." 
That one day, you'll surely be just as 
joyful as they are!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Feeling envious, feeling frustrated— 
that's proof that a desire to find your 
own happiness has taken root within you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it such a waste to stop in your 
tracks without putting that to use?! 
When your heart has already begun moving 
toward the next happiness! So...—

text_block_list.name: Dia & Blast
text_block_list.text: —Don't be afraid.

text_block_list.name: Bride Ghost
text_block_list.text:
...I'm going to hold my wedding. I know 
how you feel, Onee-chan. 
But there are people... who will celebrate 
my happiness.

text_block_list.name: Ceremony Hall Ghost
text_block_list.text:
...I understand. ...I'm sorry, too. 
Someday, I'm going to be an even happier 
bride than you.

text_block_list.name: Ceremony Hall Ghost
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Bride Ghost
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
.........Ah... 
...The presence... has faded away......

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Dia. Next time, instead of 
matching flower girls, 
let's stand side by side in our racing 
outfits.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, gladly—out on the racetrack. 
I'll be the happy one then, so... please 
celebrate for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Phew, cleaning the chapel is all done! 
We haven't heard any strange noises since 
the ceremony... Maybe the ghost is really 
gone!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we can take our photos without 
worrying! ...Hehehe. 
Hey, what hairstyles are you guys going 
with? Bu is thinking of adding some 
glitter—...Oyo?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Gentile-senpai and Cafe-senpai?! 
What's with those outfits?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Since we're staying overnight, we should 
check how our outfits match the venue. 
All to take the best possible photos.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
We have to take wonderful photos that 
surpass the ceremony we just witnessed, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... you're right! We should scout 
locations too! 
Blast-san! Gran-san!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—It suits you. 
Even under the moonlight.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Fascinating girls, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
One forgets her fear for the sake of 
others, one is unyielding in her 
conviction, 
and the other claims that nothing is 
impossible for her.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yet they are still fledglings with their 
youth lingering. 
If they oversleep tomorrow morning, we 
shall leave them behind.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. ...Yes, let's take a picture... 
all together. 
Because you all... properly followed... 
along with me...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is time I change my clothes. 
I wouldn't want to get any wrinkles on 
this racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes—...fufu. ......Yeah, ...you're right. 
It's quiet—...thanks to those 
girls......—...huh?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...A parting gift... from the "brides"...? 
Were they also... lured here in the 
past... just to be broken—?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...What does that mean...? The greatest 
malice in the mansion is............ 
something else...? —...The silence was 
only temporary............?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...—The true body... the "ruler" 
is............ 
Hating happiness, jealous of it... wanting 
to destroy it. And so—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It has begun "preparations"... to destroy 
every single one of us............
A    a    A    a
t H  i  S    i  S  n  '  T    i  t
N    o  t    I  T
t  H  i  S  !  !  !
(—Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is unlocked, you may enter. 
...? ......A draft. Please close the door 
all the way.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—Gentildonna-san, no! 
You mustn't touch the "thing" there—...!

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text: A  H  A  H  !  !
